scope: Stationary coil-to-Hall map convergence and all-channel current-box bound; no feedback or motion integration

budget.rationale: Allocate the existing numerical-error fraction of modeled scan-averaged analogue noise to total deterministic numerical field error; no ADC-code matching.
budget.scope: Engineering accuracy allocation under the nominal sensor assumptions, not a probabilistic bound or hardware noise specification.

limitations: The induced infinity norm bounds differences between discretized maps, not their unknown error against the continuous CAD wire.
All channels at their rating is a conservative superset of selected drive patterns; the attaining pattern need not be commanded by the controller.
Coil geometry and Hall positions are fixed. Magnet-field interpolation and temporal/filter reconstruction need separate allocations.
The filter and sample averaging have nonnegative unit-or-smaller gain for bounded input error; this transports the static coil-map difference bound, not other errors.
